تقادمت (form VI)
# تَقَادَمْتُ (taqādamtu) /ta.qaː.dam.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَقَادَمَ (taqādama)
# تَقَادَمْتَ (taqādamta) /ta.qaː.dam.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَقَادَمَ (taqādama)
# تَقَادَمْتِ (taqādamti) /ta.qaː.dam.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَقَادَمَ (taqādama)
# تَقَادَمَتْ (taqādamat) /ta.qaː.da.mat/: third-person fem
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
